post:
  operationId: post.workspaces.user-groups.users
  summary: Add a user to a user group
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-040000-post.workspaces.user-groups.users-happy-path.json
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521T233300Z-delete-workspaces-user-groups-users-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    LIVE-VERIFIED via lifecycle evidence: the delete.workspaces.user-groups.users probe
    (20260521T233300Z) performed the full cycle create→add_user→remove_user→delete.
    The add step (POST /user-groups/{groupId}/users body={userId}) returned HTTP 200
    with the full updated group object (userIds array populated).
    Source: user_admin.go:450 — paths.Workspace(wsID, "user-groups", groupID, "users") + POST.
    Tool: clockify_groups_add_user (supports dry_run).
    Minor discrepancy: official spec param name is 'userGroupId', ours is 'groupId' —
    cosmetic only; Spring-MVC routes on path structure, not param names.
  x-truth-iter: iter20
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: userGroupId
      in: path
      required: true
      x-ours-param-name: groupId
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            userId:
              type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Full updated group object with userIds array reflecting the new member.
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED. The typed tool clockify_groups_add_user has supported dry_run since the guardrails work. Prior lifecycle probe confirmed HTTP 200 and response shape. Param name 'userGroupId' vs 'groupId' is a cosmetic spec discrepancy — not a real discrepancy.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: post.workspaces.users.info
  summary: Filter/query workspace users with role information (POST-as-filter)
  x-verification-status: UNCONFIRMED-AGREE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-040000-post.workspaces.users.info-path-existence.json
  x-notes: |
    Internal usage: currentUserRoleGrants() (user_admin.go:737) POSTs to /users/info
    with body {page, pageSize:200, includeRoles:true, memberships:"NONE", status:"ALL"}
    to resolve the current user's role grants during UpdateUserRole operations.
    This is a POST-as-filter endpoint: body carries filter/pagination parameters.
    NOT used by clockify_users_list (which uses GET /workspaces/{wId}/users instead).
    raw_allowlist_gen.go:174 documents this path as a known Clockify route.
    Path NOT in TRUTH.openapi.yaml prior to this iter — new addition.
    API unreachable — no live GET probe possible to test 405 vs 404.
    Both our code and the raw allowlist confirm the path; treated as UNCONFIRMED-AGREE.
  x-truth-iter: iter20
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            page:
              type: integer
            pageSize:
              type: integer
            includeRoles:
              type: boolean
            memberships:
              type: string
            status:
              type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Array of user objects with optional role data
endpoints.notes: UNCONFIRMED-AGREE. New to TRUTH.yaml — path was not previously indexed. Source routing confirmed via user_admin.go:737. No live probe possible due to network outage. This is a POST-as-filter endpoint used internally for role resolution, not exposed as a typed MCP tool. Both raw allowlist and source confirm the path.
